study type: Observational comparative study with an in vitro experimental component
outcome: Expression of SLC38A1 gene and protein
Expression of SLC38A2 gene and protein
Expression of SLC38A4 gene and protein
cohort: The study included gestationally matched placental tissues from early (<34 weeks) and late (34-36 weeks) onset IUGR cases with/out preeclampsia, preterm controls, and primary trophoblast cells.
finding: SLC38A4 protein was significantly downregulated in early preterm pregnancies complicated with IUGR with/out preeclampsia, and SLC38A4 gene expression was sensitive to glucose starvation and hypoxia in primary trophoblast cells.
cross-section timing: Placental tissues were assessed at the time of delivery.
gest_age: Early preterm (<34 weeks) and late preterm (34-36 weeks) gestational ages were specifically studied for placental tissue.
